SELECT vr.registration_id, vr.registration_no, vr.variety_name, vr.crop_type, vr.enterprise_name, vr.record_status, vr.record_date, vr.record_type, vr.enterprise_type, vr.unified_social_credit_code, vr.seed_license_no, vr.variety_code, vr.species, vr.genus, vr.family, vr.breeding_method, vr.method_pedigree, vr.breeding_year, CAST(vr.min_yield_potential AS CHAR) as min_yield_potential, CAST(vr.max_yield_potential AS CHAR) as max_yield_potential, vr.disease_resistance, vr.stress_resistance, vr.growth_period, CAST(vr.plant_height AS CHAR) as plant_height, vr.grain_quality_traits, vr.test_location, vr.test_year, CAST(vr.average_yield AS CHAR) as average_yield, CAST(vr.stability_score AS CHAR) as stability_score, vr.test_report_url, vr.approval_doc_no, vr.approval_org, vr.approval_date, vr.certification_doc_url, va.audit_result, va.audit_opinion, va.reject_reason, va.auditor, va.audit_time FROM variety_registration vr LEFT JOIN variety_audit va ON vr.registration_id = va.registration_id AND va.audit_id = ( SELECT va2.audit_id FROM variety_audit va2 WHERE va2.registration_id = vr.registration_id ORDER BY va2.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 )
AND vr.variety_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{varietyName}, '%')
AND vr.enterprise_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{enterpriseName}, '%')
AND va.audit_result = #{auditResult}
ORDER BY IFNULL(va.audit_time, vr.create_time) DESC, vr.create_time DESC

SELECT vr.registration_id, vr.registration_no, vr.variety_name, vr.crop_type, vr.enterprise_name, vr.record_status, vr.record_date, vr.record_type, vr.enterprise_type, vr.unified_social_credit_code, vr.seed_license_no, vr.variety_code, vr.species, vr.genus, vr.family, vr.breeding_method, vr.method_pedigree, vr.breeding_year, CAST(vr.min_yield_potential AS CHAR) as min_yield_potential, CAST(vr.max_yield_potential AS CHAR) as max_yield_potential, vr.disease_resistance, vr.stress_resistance, vr.growth_period, CAST(vr.plant_height AS CHAR) as plant_height, vr.grain_quality_traits, vr.test_location, vr.test_year, CAST(vr.average_yield AS CHAR) as average_yield, CAST(vr.stability_score AS CHAR) as stability_score, vr.test_report_url, vr.approval_doc_no, vr.approval_org, vr.approval_date, vr.certification_doc_url, va.audit_result, va.audit_opinion, va.reject_reason, va.auditor, va.audit_time FROM variety_registration vr LEFT JOIN variety_audit va ON vr.registration_id = va.registration_id AND va.audit_id = ( SELECT va2.audit_id FROM variety_audit va2 WHERE va2.registration_id = vr.registration_id ORDER BY va2.create_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE vr.registration_id = #{registrationId}
